title: Compound eyes and ocelli of the black soldier fly, Hermetia illucens (anatomy, spectral and polarization sensitivity; lamp design for rearing)
why: The abstract reports three spectral receptor classes and polarization sensitivity but no peak wavelengths, title or authors; the full text should give the peaks (spectral range) and perhaps facet counts and interommatidial angles for Hermetia illucens.

authors: Banks MS, Sprague WW, Schmoll J, Parnell JAQ, Love GD
title: Why do animal eyes have pupils of different shapes? (Science Advances 1:e1500391, supplementary Table S1)
why: Table S1 lists pupil shape for hundreds of species by habit; it may hold Diadophis punctatus (or Colubridae) and other genera in this batch. The article page was blocked (permission request unanswered), and the escholarship copy omits the table.
get: open access; the supplementary table file on the journal page
